Receiver notice: Standalone read-only Art-Net receiver. Use only one receiver per IP/UDP port. Port conflicts are logged. Unused channel states are removed after an adapter restart.
Discovery notice: Optional ArtPoll response for Art-Net device discovery. The monitor stays discoverable even when no DMX data is currently being received.
Bind help: IPv4 address to listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept packets on all local interfaces.
Universe help: Art-Net Port-Address / Universe that should be monitored.
Start channel help: First DMX channel to expose as ioBroker states.
Channel count help: How many consecutive DMX channels should be created.
Timeout help: After this many seconds without a matching ArtDMX packet, info.receiving becomes false. info.connection remains true while the UDP listener is ready.
Only changes help: Reduces state traffic by writing only changed channel values.
Respond to poll help: Answer ArtPoll requests with an ArtPollReply so the adapter can be discovered by controllers.
Poll short name help: Short device name advertised in ArtPollReply packets (ASCII only, max. 17 characters).
